rp.title: Review replies
rp.sub: You can post one reply to each review of your products. Edits are logged, and wording that needs checking is shown after an admin review.
rp.off: Review replies are not available right now (until the admin turns them on). You can still read reviews.
rp.empty: No reviews are awaiting a reply.
rp.edited: Edited {n, plural, one {{n} time} other {{n} times}}
rp.failed: Could not save. Please try again shortly.
rp.ph: Reply to the customer review (2 to 1,000 characters · do not include phone or account numbers)
rp.hidden: A reply hidden by the admin cannot be edited.

qna.title: Product questions
qna.sub: Answer questions about your products. Answers are due {h, plural, one {{h} hour} other {{h} hours}} after a question, and late answers count toward your seller rating. Private questions are seen only by the writer, staff and the seller.
qna.off: Seller answers are turned off for now (staff answer questions until it is turned on). You can still view questions.
qna.empty: No questions are waiting for an answer.
qna.overdue: The answer is past due. Please answer soon.
qna.failed: Could not save. Please try again shortly.
qna.ph: Answer the customer question (2 to 2,000 characters; do not include contact details, account numbers or definitive health claims)
qna.hidden: Answers hidden by staff cannot be edited.

grade.title: Seller rating
grade.onNote: We send last month's rating around the 3rd of each month. If you exceed a standard in consecutive months, your products may be removed from mall listings for a while after staff review (product pages and orders stay as they are).
grade.offNote: Seller ratings are not in effect yet. The numbers below are a preview for reference.
grade.ruleLate: Late shipping — more than {p}% of orders not shipped within {d} days of payment
grade.ruleCancel: Seller-caused cancellations and returns — more than {p}% with reasons such as defects, wrong items, mismatched information or delays
grade.ruleQna: Late answers — more than {p}% of questions not answered within {h, plural, one {{h} hour} other {{h} hours}}
grade.ruleSample: A standard is not judged in a month with fewer than {o} orders or {q} questions
grade.ruleLimit: Exceeding a standard {m} months in a row may limit listing for {d} days after staff review
grade.noMonths: No ratings have been sent yet.

fc.title: This month's settlement forecast
fc.sub: Estimated from affiliate orders in {ym}. Confirmed amounts go into the next settlement, and pending ones after purchase confirmation.
fc.moneyHidden: Amounts are shown only to the owner and staff with settlement rights. Only counts are shown.
fc.canceledLine: Canceled or returned this month: {n} ({a}) · cancel rate in the last 90 days {r}
fc.madeEmpty: No settlements have been made this month yet.
fc.rewardLine: Referral rewards received {p} points · received {g} · awaiting identity check {w}
fc.note: This is an estimate from this month's affiliate orders. The payout is the amount after 3.3% withholding; referral fees between members and lead fees are not included.
